user.title: Trade Republic Insights
user.description: Put your Trade Republic CSV exports into this folder (relative to {config_dir}). The newest CSV is used. An optional prices.csv (symbol,price) overrides prices.

data.use_pytr: Also sync automatically via pytr (unofficial API)

pytr.title: Trade Republic login
pytr.description: pytr uses the unofficial Trade Republic web API. After you submit, Trade Republic sends a login confirmation to your phone. The PIN is stored in the Home Assistant config entry so the session can be renewed.

pytr_confirm.title: Confirm in the app
pytr_confirm.description: Confirm the login in the Trade Republic app, then select Submit.

pytr_confirm_code.title: Authenticator code
pytr_confirm_code.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

reauth_confirm.title: Trade Republic session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your PIN to start a new login.

error.phone_format: Use the international format, for example +4915112345678.
error.pytr_install_failed: pytr could not be installed. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check the phone number and PIN, then try again.
error.not_confirmed: The login is not confirmed yet. Confirm it in the app, then select Submit again.
